method: per-criterion median across three judges, then weighted by the rubric

notes.problem: Cold box, white trailer doors, painted stripe clerestory.
notes.fix: Darken the trailer doors, warm the walls, real lit glazing.

notes.problem: Cold navy facade, bright trailer doors.
notes.fix: Warm key on the lit end as one pool, darken the trailer doors.

notes.problem: Cold exterior, primitive trailers, plant unsizeable, dead court.
notes.fix: Pull back so the whole wall fits with one truck and person, warm rake, doors down.

notes.problem: Primitive worker, white yard, no jamb, stubs read as bollards.
notes.fix: Dark jamb across the left third; drop or silhouette the worker; low flush stubs.

notes.problem: Worker face draws the eye, white yard, no jamb.
notes.fix: Backlit worker silhouette, yard down, black jamb.

notes.problem: Near-white yard, missing jamb, plastic worker.
notes.fix: Dark jamb on the left edge, yard exposure down.

notes.problem: Grey rack faces, tabs as a string of keys, fibre shadows.
notes.fix: Crop to one switch, steel to near black, fibre into a tray.

notes.problem: Garland of modules on a grey rack wall.
notes.fix: One column of seated modules down a dark aisle under one raking key.

notes.problem: Grey midtone rack wall, stock look.
notes.fix: Crop to one rack face under one raking light.

notes.problem: Thick rod and board pennants read as a barrier; mid sky with a horizon band.
notes.fix: 3 mm cord, fluttering strips, eye at 0.6 m, fog the band.

notes.problem: Water ground, flat horizon band, flat pennants.
notes.fix: Graded clay, fog the horizon, tie strips to the stakes.

notes.problem: Overlit pale worker; truss behind the hook.
notes.fix: Door-side rim only; truss to black.

notes.problem: Overexposed kit worker; cords in mid-air; about fourteen pads.
notes.fix: Raise the camera for all twenty pads; cut or silhouette the worker.

notes.problem: Mid-brown field, knife read, fingers cropped.
notes.fix: Pull back, whole module and tape corner in frame, floor to black.

notes.problem: Brown midtone field, fingers cropped, no tape corner.
notes.fix: Darken outside a tight pool, fingers and tape corner in frame.

rounds_source: this module's own log of cards it has scored
shortfall: at the round cap the finished deck ships at 6.832, 1.168 under the 8.0 top rung. Name that in the email and the run record
craft_note: at the round cap the craft floor stands down. The art median 6.3 is under 8.5 and the deck ships as it is. Name it in the run record
